$comment: Provisional canonical identifier. This capability demonstrates that Discovery is broader than cryptography. Only a small language preference is defined in 1.0.
title: Preferences capability
description: Communication preferences for a mailbox. This initial shape is intentionally small. Additional preference types SHOULD be added additively in later minor versions or as extensions.

languages.description: Preferred languages as BCP 47 language tags (for example en, en-US, ur). Order SHOULD be most-preferred first. This schema does not fully validate the BCP 47 grammar.
